item.title: Galmudug president opens new hospital in Dhusamareb
item.description: The president of Galmudug on Tuesday opened a new 60-bed hospital in Dhusamareb, the state capital, funded partly by the diaspora.

item.title: Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya oo shir muhiim ah ku qabtay Muqdisho
item.description: Madaxweynaha ayaa maanta Muqdisho ku qabtay shir uu la yeeshay wasiirrada, waxaana lagu falanqeeyay xaaladda dalka iyo arrimaha amniga.
